title: Vikas Asthana v. State of U.P. and Another
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Manoj Kumar Gupta and Umesh Chandra Sharma, JJ.
disposition: Provisional theft assessment quashed for fresh Supply Code order.
headnote: Provisional assessment dated 23 February 2023 for alleged theft of electricity quashed. The order was vague and confusing, recorded no proper findings, and did not deal with the consumer's objections. The Electricity Department may pass a fresh order strictly in accordance with the procedure prescribed under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. Petition disposed of.
facts: Vikas Asthana challenged, before the Allahabad High Court, a provisional assessment bill dated 23 February 2023 and the recovery proceedings that followed it. The bill was raised by the Electricity Department in a case of alleged theft of electricity. He said the Department had not considered the objection he had filed, and that the order recorded none of the findings the law requires. Counsel for the Department asked the Court for liberty to pass a fresh order.

reusable_constructions.construction: A provisional assessment for alleged theft of electricity that is vague, records no proper findings, and does not deal with the consumer's objections is liable to be quashed.
After that quashing, the licensee may pass a fresh order only by strictly following the procedure prescribed under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005.
